issuance.proxy: NI Lo 20 minus Hi 20; long leg < 0

long_term.note: Blend of top-quintile value-weighted portfolios (B/M, OP, low INV, low NSI); insiders excluded (no history). Net of costs.

market_neutral.note: Equal-dollar factor long/shorts (HML, Mom with crash guard, RMW, CMA, NSI) on T-bill collateral; insiders/short interest excluded. Book scaled by lagged sentiment. Net of costs.

absolute_return.note: Long-only blend incl. low-vol, volatility-targeted (10%), x regime multiplier, stock sleeve halved when the market is below its 10-month average, 30% trend sleeve, 15% drawdown brake. Net of costs.

columns_used.issuance: NI Lo 20 minus Hi 20; long leg < 0

market.note: CRSP value-weighted market (Ken French) as the SPY stand-in before 1993

notes.survivorship: Factor-level results use Ken French CRSP portfolios (survivorship-free, delisting returns included). Stock-level results use today's S&P 1500 and are survivorship-biased.
notes.look_ahead: Credit data lagged 2 quarters; house prices 2 months; Baker-Wurgler 1 month (its PCA is estimated on the full sample). Fundamentals enter only after their SEC filing date.
